meta.note: Built-in obligations of the Crusader Knight class: not bought, give no CP. The price of 12+ years of Order training from age 6-7 (STR ~47 at start) is no profession and these vows.

chastity.rule: No brothels, no lovers; Templars: no contact with women (existing rule).

poverty.rule: Owns only arms, armour, horse, habit; 12% of loot to alms; cannot take Resources.

obedience.rule: Must answer the Order's summons and orders.

purity.rule: Keep Virtue high; no Veil contact; corruption purged at once.

no_profession.rule: Cannot take Profession Training. Maintains own gear (sharpen, oil, patch straps), cannot forge or repair plate: the Order's servants and armourers do that.

discipline_ladder.name: stripped
discipline_ladder.effect: loses horse and arms for a month

discipline_ladder.name: expulsion
discipline_ladder.effect: class abilities locked; becomes Fallen Knight (enemy of the Order, free Nemesis intensity 3, no CP)

breath.rule: Passive only (core_rules.txt). No visible light. The knight knows something is happening, not why.

effects.creature_avoids: corrupted foes prefer other targets (morale test to engage him)

breath.steel_rule: Low Virtue never lowers his normal weapon damage, only removes the Breath.
